name: usage-band
description: A line above the prompt with the five-hour and seven-day limit windows, this session's context fill and cost, plus a nudge to clear when the window gets expensive. The footer shows the cost in Singapore dollars.

sgdRate.title: USD to SGD rate
sgdRate.description: Multiplies the session's USD cost into the S$ label at the right of the prompt footer. /usage-band sgd off hides it.
